intro.en: The neuter lo: lo de, lo plus adjective plus que, lo mío, and the set phrases built on it.

lo cansada que.nota: The adjective agrees with the person or thing, not with lo.

texto.en:
**Lo** is the neuter article. It never stands before a noun.

- **lo** + adjective makes an idea: **lo bueno**, **lo importante**, **lo mejor**.
- **lo de** + noun, infinitive or adverb points at a matter both speakers know about: ¿sabes **lo de** Ana? Siento **lo de** ayer. **Lo de** trabajar en casa me gusta.
- **lo** + adjective or adverb + **que** means how, with force. The adjective agrees: no sabes **lo cansada que** estoy. Mira **lo bien que** canta. Me sorprende **lo caras que** son.
- **lo** + possessive is my thing, your thing: la cocina no es **lo mío**.
- **lo que** is what.

Set phrases: **a lo mejor**, **por lo menos**, **por lo visto**, **por lo general**, **lo antes posible**, **a lo lejos**.

filas: No sabes lo cara que es.
You don't know how expensive it is.
I don't know what he wants.

frases.es: Siento lo de ayer. No debería haber gritado.
frases.en: I'm sorry about yesterday. I shouldn't have shouted.

frases.es: Tranquila. Lo importante es que lo hemos hablado.
frases.en: Don't worry. The important thing is that we've talked about it.

frases.es: No te imaginas lo cansada que estaba.
frases.en: You can't imagine how tired I was.

frases.es: Por lo visto, lo de la mudanza ha sido duro.
frases.en: Apparently, the business of the move has been hard.

frases.es: Las cajas no son lo mío. Pero mira lo bien que ha quedado el salón.
frases.en: Boxes aren't my thing. But look how well the living room has turned out.

que.en: Lo que needs a verb after it.

del.en: There is no el to join with.

pregunta.en: Complete: you don't know how expensive they are. (las casas)

caro.en: The adjective agrees with what it describes.

El.en: El difícil would be the difficult man or thing.

That would be no tengo cocina.

texto.en: As you can see, he isn't coming.

explicacion.en: Por lo visto reports what one has heard.
Por lo visto is a fixed phrase: apparently.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a message to a friend about several pending matters without naming them fully: lo de…, lo que…, lo bueno es que…

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Comment aloud on the best, the worst and the strangest thing about the year so far.
